children: IonQ, Inc. (NYSE:IONQ) lifted 2026 revenue guidance to $450–$460M aided by the SkyWater deal, unveiled the Superion 256 platform and saw shares jump, while detailing that a ~20,000‑physical‑qubit machine could crack secp256k1 in ~25.7 days and won an $8.18M PQC/QKD deal with Congruity360.
IonQ Revenue Guide Increase, SkyWater Acquisition
: IonQ raised 2026 revenue guide to $450–$460M, citing ~$170M from SkyWater acquisition (effective Jul 31–Dec 31, 2026). Also unveiled Superion 256 platform; shares jumped ~5.5% premarket to $41.70.
: IonQ says a ~20,000‑physical‑qubit trapped‑ion machine (19,397 phys., 1,457 logical qubits) could break secp256k1 in ~25.7 days per run using Shor’s algorithm, needing ~39M logical Toffoli gates.
IonQ PQC QKD Deal With Congruity360
: IonQ agreed on an $8.18M deal to integrate its PQC and QKD appliances into Congruity360’s data platform to secure enterprise unstructured data in transit across the U.S.
